name: Deconstruct Face Gel Sunscreen SPF 55 + and PA+++ 50gm | Gel based sunscreen for oily, combination skin, normal skin | Broad spectrum sunscreen, No White Cast, Lightweight
description:
Deconstruct Face Gel Sunscreen SPF 55+ PA+++ 50g

Protect your skin while keeping it fresh and lightweight with Deconstruct Face Gel Sunscreen SPF 55+ PA+++. This gel-based sunscreen is perfect for oily, combination, and normal skin types, providing broad-spectrum protection against harmful UVA and UVB rays without leaving a white cast.

Key Features:

SPF & PA Rating: SPF 55+ and PA+++ for high sun protection.

Skin Type: Suitable for oily, combination, and normal skin.

Texture: Lightweight gel that absorbs quickly without greasiness.

No White Cast: Leaves skin looking natural and radiant.

Broad-Spectrum Protection: Shields against UVA and UVB rays.

Keep your skin protected, hydrated, and shine-free with Deconstruct Face Gel Sunscreen SPF 55+ PA+++.
